mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.cover, a.excerpt, a.author_id AS authorId, pu.nickname AS authorName, pu.avatar AS authorAvatar, COUNT(DISTINCT et.tag_id) AS score FROM portal_article a INNER JOIN portal_entity_tag et ON et.entity_id = a.id AND et.entity_type = 'article' LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = a.author_id WHERE a.status = 'published' AND et.tag_id IN ( SELECT et2.tag_id FROM portal_entity_tag et2 INNER JOIN portal_like l ON l.article_id = et2.entity_id AND et2.entity_type = 'article' WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} ) AND a.id NOT IN (SELECT article_id FROM portal_like WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND a.id NOT IN (SELECT article_id FROM portal_article_view WHERE user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY a.id, a.title, a.cover, a.excerpt, a.author_id, pu.nickname, pu.avatar ORDER BY score DESC, a.views DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.cover, a.excerpt, a.author_id AS authorId, pu.nickname AS authorName, pu.avatar AS authorAvatar, COUNT(*) AS score FROM portal_like l2 INNER JOIN portal_article a ON a.id = l2.article_id AND a.status = 'published' LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = a.author_id WHERE l2.user_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l1.user_id FROM portal_like l1 INNER JOIN portal_like l3 ON l3.article_id = l1.article_id WHERE l3.user_id = #{userId} AND l1.user_id <> #{userId} ) AND l2.article_id NOT IN (SELECT article_id FROM portal_like WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND l2.article_id NOT IN (SELECT article_id FROM portal_article_view WHERE user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY a.id, a.title, a.cover, a.excerpt, a.author_id, pu.nickname, pu.avatar ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.cover, a.excerpt, a.author_id AS authorId, pu.nickname AS authorName, pu.avatar AS authorAvatar, (COALESCE(a.views, 0) + COALESCE(a.likes, 0) * 5) AS score FROM portal_article a LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = a.author_id WHERE a.status = 'published' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.cover, q.description AS excerpt, q.difficulty AS extra, q.tags, COUNT(DISTINCT et.tag_id) AS score FROM portal_interview_question q INNER JOIN portal_entity_tag et ON et.entity_id = q.id AND et.entity_type = 'interview_question' WHERE q.status = 'active' AND et.tag_id IN ( SELECT et2.tag_id FROM portal_entity_tag et2 WHERE et2.entity_type = 'interview_question' AND et2.entity_id IN ( SELECT question_id FROM portal_interview_question_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT question_id FROM portal_interview_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT question_id FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) ) AND q.id NOT IN (SELECT question_id FROM portal_interview_question_like WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND q.id NOT IN (SELECT question_id FROM portal_interview_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND q.id NOT IN (SELECT question_id FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY q.id, q.title, q.cover, q.description, q.difficulty, q.tags ORDER BY score DESC, q.submission_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.cover, q.description AS excerpt, q.difficulty AS extra, q.tags, COUNT(*) AS score FROM ( SELECT question_id, user_id FROM portal_interview_question_like UNION ALL SELECT question_id, user_id FROM portal_interview_bookmark ) act INNER JOIN portal_interview_question q ON q.id = act.question_id AND q.status = 'active' WHERE act.user_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT s1.user_id FROM ( SELECT question_id, user_id FROM portal_interview_question_like UNION ALL SELECT question_id, user_id FROM portal_interview_bookmark UNION ALL SELECT question_id, user_id FROM portal_interview_submission ) s1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT question_id, user_id FROM portal_interview_question_like UNION ALL SELECT question_id, user_id FROM portal_interview_bookmark UNION ALL SELECT question_id, user_id FROM portal_interview_submission ) s3 ON s3.question_id = s1.question_id WHERE s3.user_id = #{userId} AND s1.user_id <> #{userId} ) AND act.question_id NOT IN (SELECT question_id FROM portal_interview_question_like WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND act.question_id NOT IN (SELECT question_id FROM portal_interview_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND act.question_id NOT IN (SELECT question_id FROM portal_interview_submission WHERE user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY q.id, q.title, q.cover, q.description, q.difficulty, q.tags ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT q.id, q.title, q.cover, q.description AS excerpt, q.difficulty AS extra, q.tags, (COALESCE(q.like_count, 0) * 5 + COALESCE(q.submission_count, 0)) AS score FROM portal_interview_question q WHERE q.status = 'active' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.cover, b.summary AS excerpt, b.author AS authorName, b.tags, (COALESCE(b.rating, 0) + COALESCE(b.reading_count, 0) / 100) AS score FROM portal_book b WHERE b.status = 'active' AND b.id NOT IN (SELECT book_id FROM portal_bookshelf WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND ( b.category_id IN ( SELECT bk.book_id_cat FROM ( SELECT bb.category_id AS book_id_cat FROM portal_bookshelf bs INNER JOIN portal_book bb ON bb.id = bs.book_id WHERE bs.user_id = #{userId} AND bb.category_id IS NOT NULL ) t ) OR b.author IN ( SELECT bb.author FROM portal_bookshelf bs INNER JOIN portal_book bb ON bb.id = bs.book_id WHERE bs.user_id = #{userId} AND bb.author IS NOT NULL ) ) ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.cover, b.summary AS excerpt, b.author AS authorName, b.tags, COUNT(*) AS score FROM portal_bookshelf bs2 INNER JOIN portal_book b ON b.id = bs2.book_id AND b.status = 'active' WHERE bs2.user_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT bs1.user_id FROM portal_bookshelf bs1 INNER JOIN portal_bookshelf bs3 ON bs3.book_id = bs1.book_id WHERE bs3.user_id = #{userId} AND bs1.user_id <> #{userId} ) AND bs2.book_id NOT IN (SELECT book_id FROM portal_bookshelf WHERE user_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY b.id, b.title, b.cover, b.summary, b.author, b.tags ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.cover, b.summary AS excerpt, b.author AS authorName, b.tags, (COALESCE(b.rating, 0) * 2 + COALESCE(b.reading_count, 0)) AS score FROM portal_book b WHERE b.status = 'active' ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.id, u.nickname AS title, u.avatar AS cover, u.bio AS excerpt, COUNT(*) AS score FROM portal_follow f2 INNER JOIN portal_user u ON u.id = f2.following_id AND u.status = '0' WHERE f2.follower_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT f1.follower_id FROM portal_follow f1 INNER JOIN portal_follow f3 ON f3.following_id = f1.following_id WHERE f3.follower_id = #{userId} AND f1.follower_id <> #{userId} ) AND f2.following_id <> #{userId} AND f2.following_id NOT IN (SELECT following_id FROM portal_follow WHERE follower_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.bio ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.id, u.nickname AS title, u.avatar AS cover, u.bio AS excerpt, COALESCE(SUM(a.views), 0) AS score FROM portal_user u LEFT JOIN portal_article a ON a.author_id = u.id AND a.status = 'published' WHERE u.status = '0' GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.bio ORDER BY score DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
